title: ハッカーのマナGPU・短縮分の蓄積 R1

producer.semantics: Eligible playing passive accrues fractional carry, spends when at least 0.01 MP is available and converts the computed spend at 20000 ms/MP into stored cooldown credit. useAlchemy consumes that credit separately at lines 15532–15537. This example represents a single ordinary confirmed accrual without modifying the active cooldown.

design.subject: Mana charge travels from a short cyan feed to the central compute die. Its warm output follows a common conductor into one or two register windows, each storing 200 ms for a future generation.
design.display: 202 by 64 logical px assembly, inset as a single viewer-owned instrument. Reduced motion keeps the incoming charge at the feed and suppresses traveling register pulses while preserving die and register states.
design.postEffect: Local compute-die color response and window latching, confined to the board.
design.audio: Input tone sweep followed by a detent for each actual deposit. Verify mode forced silent.

scope: Two explicit single-step own fixtures with initial zero stored credit and regular mana cost, 0.01→200 ms or 0.02→400 ms. No automatic tick subscription, previous balance reconstruction or conversion-result/cooldown change. Carry only, meeting, later credit usage, snapshot, mismatched causes and foreign records are rejected. No other actor or map data.

validation.bounded: Eight UI conditions, unknown choice, strict financial values/same-cause/owner/id dedup/old snapshot tests, host syntax and fixture/control mapping.
validation.audio: Generated PCM for both deposit counts at 8, 44.1, 48 and 96 kHz. Both variants have expected input/first tap, only two-cell variant has second tap; finite bounded samples and silence at both ends.
validation.runtimeReadback: 4/4 exact source text and Git blob checks at immutable runtime commit
